summary: BUG-2 fixed by making Command Composer routing explicit. Mismatched explicit target agent now defaults to agent-only routing unless task context is explicitly included.
root_cause: frontend/src/App.tsx submitInterrupt always sent selectedTask id/owner while also sending explicit targetAgent as task_assignee/additional_agents. Because selectedTask defaulted to projection.tasks[0], a target-agent interrupt could also wake the unrelated selected task owner.
verification: npm run build passed in frontend/
Browser smoke at http://127.0.0.1:8787/ showed Include task context unchecked and AGENT ONLY when target runtime-helper-2 differed from selected task owner runtime-worker-1.

Live DB event seq107 from the smoke interrupt had task_id null, routing_mode agent-only, include_selected_task false, and affected_agents controller, observer, runtime-helper-2, qa. It did not include runtime-worker-1.
